name: boss-zhipin-resume-sync
description: Parse a local resume document and synchronize it into a user-authorized BOSS Zhipin online resume through Microsoft Edge.

interface.shortDescription: Parse and sync resumes to BOSS Zhipin
interface.longDescription: Use an uploaded PDF, DOCX, HTML, Markdown, or text resume to update the signed-in BOSS Zhipin online resume in Microsoft Edge. The shared skill and Node CLI work across Codex, Claude Code, and DeepSeek Harness.
defaultPrompt: Parse this resume and sync it to my BOSS Zhipin online resume
Compare this PDF with my BOSS resume and update only the changed sections
Sync this DOCX to BOSS Zhipin while preserving my project experience
